Business Wire announcement (2018-03-06) referenced in wiki_citations could not be accessed to verify whether initial proposal or cancellation. Unable to source a cancellation date or cancellation verdict. Marking verdict='unclear' with tier=low. To confirm 'cancelled' with ShelvedCancelledType='confirmed' would require a dated Tall Oak announcement, FERC withdrawal order (unlikely if purely intrastate), or regulatory finding. Recommend escalation to user for business judgment on whether to reclassify as 'shelved' (inferred, no recent activity) pending new news.
